description: sandbox-ops-v1 exec_start payload vectors (docs/sandbox-ops-v1.md, Exec payload). payload_b64 is the exact payload byte string. Every implementation that reads a payload (gateway policy, validator, miner, audit) must accept each 'accept' vector with exactly the decoded members and refuse every 'reject' vector; a parser that reads different members from the same bytes breaks the payload_digest binding.

accept.name: member order and whitespace are free
utf-8 argument escaped incl. surrogate pair

reject.name: case-variant member instead of the real one
